name: modula3
description: Modula-3: syntax highlighting, errors, hovers and declarations from the language server of m3j, and its debugger

m3j.home.description: The directory of m3j, with m3_lang_server.jar, m3j.jar and m3build.jar (empty: the environment variable M3J_HOME).

m3j.java.description: The java program (of a JDK 25 or later) that runs the language server and the debugger (empty: JAVA_HOME/bin/java, else java from the PATH).

m3j.server.description: Run the language server (errors and warnings, hovers, declarations). Without it there is only syntax highlighting.

package.description: The directory of the package (with src/m3makefile) whose program is debugged, as m3build builds it in the directory JVM.

program.description: The program of the package, if it has several.

jar.description: Instead of package: the jar of a program that m3j compiled.

build.description: Build the package with m3build first (its output is in the Debug Console).

cwd.description: The working directory of the program (default: the package).

env.description: Environment variables of the program (null removes one).

javaOptions.description: Options of java, after those of java_option in the m3makefile.

classpath.description: More jars and directories of Java classes, after those of java_classpath.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first line of the main module.

enumDescriptions: The output of the program in the Debug Console; it reads no input.
The program in the integrated terminal, where it can read its input.
The program in a terminal of the system.

sourceRoots.description: More directories with sources of Modula-3, for the files of the stack (the package and the library of m3j are searched anyway).

port.description: The port of the program, which runs with -agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,address=PORT.

package.description: The directory of the package of the program, for its sources.

sourceRoots.description: More directories with sources of Modula-3, for the files of the stack (the package and the library of m3j are searched anyway).
